verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a CLI (@hubspot/cli), REST endpoints, per-endpoint OpenAPI specs, and MCP servers, but none of it shows an official language SDK or client library. The CLI is an adjacent tool, and OpenAPI specs are developer building blocks from which an SDK could be generated, not an SDK itself. The MCP servers belong to a different story. Official SDKs are a fair question for a SaaS CRM platform, so this axis applies and the lack of evidence makes the verdict "none".
